title: Afternoon pivot call list — Noah Chen
content:
Afternoon pivot notes (18 Jun) — quick, tactical.

Context: morning blitz produced a few warm replies but many no-answers. Shift focus to rescue 3-5 deals and spray quick high-probability follow-ups. Goal: 3 qualified meetings booked before EOD or tomorrow AM.

Priority buckets (immediate):
- High (rescue / warm): immediate call + SMS + short follow-up email same thread
- Medium (cold replies / open threads): quick value add + 1 question to re-engage
- Low (no reply, no activity >30d): log as nurture, set 30d task

Today call list (timebox: 1:00–3:00pm) — target windows in notes:
1) Acme Retail (Charlotte) — warm demo interest, said pricing eval; previous contact: 2026-06-15 email.
   - Window: 1:05–1:20pm
   - Disposition options: [Booked demo], [Left VM], [Send follow-up email]
   - Quick script: "Charlotte, Noah here from Redwood Inference — saw you were evaluating inference runtimes. Quick question: are you optimizing for latency or unit cost?"
   - Next action: if VM, follow-up with 2-line email + one bullet benefit

2) BrightHealth Platform (DM lead) — trial user, usage spike but billing question unresolved.
   - Window: 1:30–1:45pm
   - Goal: confirm trial expansion timeline
   - Quick script: "Hey Sam, noticed your trial spiked — want to walk through paging/kept KV cache options that cut costs 20%?"

3) Fenwick Logistics (no-show on prior demo) — re-open conversation, offer canary pilot (1 week).
   - Window: 2:00–2:15pm
   - Script: "We can run a short dedicated pilot to prove throughput — have 2 GPUs reserved next week. Interested?"

4) Gamma Analytics (follow-up) — asked for integration docs; decision maker not on initial thread.
   - Window: 2:20–2:35pm
   - Action: ask for stakeholder intro; suggest 15-min tech sync

Quick voicemail script (20–25s):
- "Hi [Name], Noah Chen at Redwood Inference. We helped [peer company] cut inference cost ~30% while holding latency targets. Quick 10-minute chat to see if we can do the same for you? My number is XXX-XXX-XXXX. Thanks!"

Two-line follow-up email template (use thread reply):
- Subject: quick follow on {company}
- Body: "Hi {Name} — following up quickly. We can show a short pilot that validates latency + cost tradeoffs in <7 days. 15-min this week? — Noah"

Disposition shorthand to use in CRM:
- WARM_BOOK: meeting confirmed
- VM_LEFT: left voicemail, email sent
- ENGAGE_Q: asked clarifying question, awaiting reply
- NEED_INTRO: want DM intro
- NURTURE_30D: deprioritized, set 30d task

Pipeline rescue checklist (for each high-priority account):
- Check last 3 interactions in CRM and mark any missing notes
- Confirm contact is still at company (LinkedIn quick check)
- Prepare one specific ROI stat relevant to them (latency / cost / throughput)
- If demo already run, propose a concrete next step (pilot, POC, pricing conversation)

Follow-ups to send (EOD tasks):
- Send BrightHealth quick recap + link to docs (target: 6pm)
- Email Fenwick pilot offer with proposed dates (target: 5:30pm)
- Create task for Gamma Analytics: get stakeholder intro (target: tomorrow AM)

Notes to self (scratch, not for record):
- Stop trying to deep-dive feature lists on first outbound — focus on 1 tangible value prop (reduce token costs via batching/caching OR lower latency w/ tuned kernels)
- Use the "pilot" framing more (low friction, short timebox) — closes faster than big PO requests
- If a prospect mentions "compliance", tag for Private offering follow-up and loop in Olivia

Micro-experiments to run this week (log results in Confluence-REPO-42):
- Short A/B voicemail: "cost saving" vs "latency guarantee" (record outcomes)
- Two-line email variants: question-led vs benefit-led (track reply rate)

End-of-day quick metrics to capture: replies, meetings booked, pilots initiated, moved-to-nurture.

Next actions (tomorrow AM):
- 9:00am quick sync with Maya to triage heavy accounts
- 11:00am follow-up batch for nurture list

Random reminders:
- Update demo deck with 1 new slide showing Dedicated vs Hosted economics (numbers from finance deck)
- Add kernel-optimization note to technical FAQ for Gamma call

-- Noah
